description: Real-time market trades - all trades executed on the exchange

unsubscribe_request.product_ids: optional - specific products to unsubscribe from

notes: Market trades represent all trades that executed, regardless of origin. Update messages can contain 1 to many trades depending on trading volume in the last 250ms.
use_case: Track all executed trades, monitor market activity, detect large orders, build trade volume indicators
batching: Trades are batched - snapshot contains trades, update contains trades from last 250ms
